name: dropbox
description: Browse, search, download and save files in the user's Dropbox.
summary: Browse, search and manage files in Dropbox
instructions:
1. Create an app at https://www.dropbox.com/developers/apps with Scoped access. Pick App folder to limit Stavrobot to /Apps/<app name>, or Full Dropbox.
2. On the app's Permissions tab enable files.metadata.read, files.content.read, files.content.write, sharing.read and sharing.write, then Submit. Do this before connecting, a token only gets the scopes enabled when it was issued.
3. Set app_key and app_secret from the app's Settings tab.
4. Ask Stavrobot to connect Dropbox. It sends you a link, you allow access and paste back the code Dropbox shows.

app_key.description: App key, from the Settings tab of your app in the Dropbox App Console.

app_secret.description: App secret, from the same Settings tab.

refresh_token.description: Set by the auth_complete tool, no need to fill it in.
